title: Counter Removal Race (Order of Zeroing countermax)
pattern: Zeroing a thread-local counter before zeroing its corresponding safety limit (`countermax`).
why_bad: This creates a critical race condition. If the counter is cleared first, a concurrent thread can immediately increment the counter again before the limit `countermax` is set to zero, completely bypassing the safety boundary and resulting in an unchecked leak or overflow.
detection: Look for cleanup routines that write to tracking values before writing to their associated limit/validation boundaries.
counterexample: Only valid if the local thread is completely blocked or guaranteed thread-isolated during cleanup.
strength: Strong` — structural instruction reordering race condition that negates limit-enforcement invariants.
